text: A queen's throne came from a far-off land... before an eye could blink.
And the king who received it did not boast. He said: "This is from the favour of my Lord, to test me."
This is the story of Prophet Sulaiman, alayhis salaam: the king who understood the birds, heard an ant, commanded the wind...
...and how one grateful heart turned a whole nation from the sun to Allah.
But first, a question: what does a man say, when Allah gives him everything?
The King Who Was Grateful. The story of Prophet Sulaiman, alayhis salaam.
